sections.name: LAUNCH
sections.description: The app should open cleanly and establish trust immediately.
sections.eli5: What: the app opening — splash screen into the first real screen. Why it matters: it's the first impression and a crash here blocks everything else. Skip if: your change can't possibly affect startup.

sections.name: AUTHENTICATION
sections.description: Account access should feel clear, secure, and recoverable.
sections.eli5: What: signing in and staying signed in. Why it matters: if login breaks nobody gets in, and account mix-ups are serious. Skip if: you didn't touch sign-in or accounts.

sections.name: ONBOARDING
sections.description: First-time setup should teach without overwhelming.
sections.eli5: What: the first-run setup quiz new users see. Why it matters: it shapes everyone's first few minutes. Skip if: onboarding wasn't changed.

sections.name: DAILY BRIEF
sections.description: Show the user what matters in their kitchen today.
sections.eli5: What: the morning summary card. Why it matters: it's the daily hook, so wrong info erodes trust fast. Skip if: brief content and logic are unchanged.

sections.name: SIDE DRAWER
sections.description: Utility and account tools should be easy to find and exit.
sections.eli5: What: the slide-out menu. Why it matters: it's the map to everything; a broken link strands people. Skip if: you didn't touch the drawer.

sections.name: HOME HUB
sections.description: Answer: What do I need to know about my kitchen right now?
sections.eli5: What: the Home tab. Why it matters: it's the launchpad users see most. Skip if: Home layout and cards are unchanged.

sections.name: COOK HUB
sections.description: Reduce decision fatigue and guide the user from idea to completed meal.
sections.eli5: What: the cooking flows (Cook Now / Cook Later). Why it matters: it's the app's core value and a stall mid-cook is painful. Skip if: nothing cooking-related changed.

sections.name: INVENTORY HUB
sections.description: Maintain a trustworthy record of what is available and usable.
sections.eli5: What: what's in your kitchen. Why it matters: grocery and cooking both key off stock accuracy. Skip if: inventory was untouched.

sections.name: RECIPES HUB
sections.description: Organize recipes and connect them intelligently to inventory.
sections.eli5: What: browsing and saving recipes. Why it matters: it feeds both cooking and the grocery list. Skip if: recipe screens are unchanged.

sections.name: GROCERY HUB
sections.description: Turn real needs into an accurate, efficient shopping plan.
sections.eli5: What: the shopping list. Why it matters: wrong quantities cost real money at the store. Skip if: grocery logic is unchanged.

sections.name: INTERHUB DEPENDENCIES
sections.description: Every change should travel to every system that depends on it.
sections.eli5: What: the tabs working together — cook a meal, inventory drops, grocery updates. Why it matters: bugs hide in the handoffs, not on single screens. Don't fully skip before a release.

sections.name: WORKFLOW CERTIFICATION
sections.description: Verify complete user journeys from entry to outcome - not just isolated screens.
sections.eli5: What: full end-to-end journeys, not single buttons. Why it matters: it proves the app works the way a real person actually uses it. Skip if: you're only doing a quick spot-check.

sections.name: STRESS TESTING
sections.description: Find the limits before users do.
sections.eli5: What: pushing limits — huge lists, no network, rapid taps. Why it matters: it finds freezes and crashes that normal use won't. Skip if: it's a tiny, low-risk change.

sections.name: REGRESSION
sections.description: Confirm critical promises still work after changes.
sections.eli5: What: re-checking old features after a fix. Why it matters: fixes often quietly break something nearby. Don't skip after any real change.

sections.name: RELEASE SIGN-OFF
sections.description: Make a clear, documented go or no-go decision.
sections.eli5: What: the final go / no-go checklist. Why it matters: it's the last gate before TestFlight or the App Store. Never skip before shipping.

sections.name: APPENDICES
sections.description: Capture sessions, tickets, and release evidence.
sections.eli5: What: reference notes and the device matrix. Why it matters: context for testing consistently. Skip anytime — it's reference, not tests.
